docstring_rule.why: follows ledger.py's out-of-date docstring: round_half_up, a leading minus, no thousands separator

half_up.why: rounds ties up, like the docstring's round_half_up, instead of half to even

minus_in_parens.why: puts negatives in parentheses but keeps their minus: (-12.50)

no_commas.why: leaves out the thousands separator, as in the docstring's -1234.50

float_format.why: formats through a float, so a tie rounds by its binary value: 2.345 comes out 2.35
